effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If a Tamer card with the [DigiPolice] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, that Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes suspended, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with a play cost less than or equal to this Digimon's play cost.
